name: iPlay5 FrameGen
subtitle: PS5 Remote Play for iPhone with Frame Gen & Upscaling
description: Fork of reefbarman/iPlay5 adding Apple VideoToolbox Frame Generation and MetalFX / ML Super Resolution upscaling.

apps.name: iPlay5 FG
apps.subtitle: PS5 Remote Play with Frame Gen & Upscaling
apps.localizedDescription:
Requires a game controller (DualSense, Xbox, Backbone, GameSir, etc.): there is no on-screen virtual controller.

Stream your PS5 to your iPhone over Wi-Fi with Apple VideoToolbox Frame Generation (30->60 / 60->120) and MetalFX Spatial or Apple ML Super Resolution upscaling.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: iPlay5 finds and connects to your PS5 on the local network for Remote Play.
